key_points.text: Together, they're spearheading the development of QIS-driven solutions at Simplify Asset Management.
key_points.evidence_quote: Together, they're spearheading the development of QIS-driven solutions at Simplify Asset Management.

thesis: The speakers argue that Simplify Asset Management offers a streamlined, entrepreneurial alternative to large institutions by leveraging decades of institutional expertise in QIS derivatives to provide defensive edges, carry plays, and real-time risk management tools. They contend that this agile environment allows for rapid innovation and access to sophisticated, uncorrelated return strategies for advisors and individuals, though it demands precise optimization of every move.
